name: OpenBesluitvorming - Document Worker
description: Full-document Open Besluitvorming worker. It persists available source metadata, uses bounded embedding batches and weighted mean pooling, and records individual dead letters.

parameters.jsCode: const results=$input.all(), originals=$('2. Split Documents').all(); return results.map((result,index)=>{const original=originals[index]?.json;if(!original)return {json:{outcome:'dead_letter',stage:'entity_detail',code:'input_alignment_failed',message:'Could not align entity response'}};if(result.error||result.json?.error)return {json:{outcome:'dead_letter',runId:original.runId,sourceKey:original.sourceKey,entityId:original.entityId,stage:'entity_detail',code:'http_failure',message:String((result.error||result.json?.error).message||'Entity fetch failed').slice(0,500)}};const detail=result.json||{},text=String(detail.markdownText||detail.markdown_text||'');if(!text.trim())return {json:{outcome:'dead_letter',runId:original.runId,sourceKey:original.sourceKey,entityId:original.entityId,stage:'validation',code:'empty_content',message:'Entity has no indexable markdown text'}};return {json:{outcome:'continue',runId:original.runId,sourceKey:original.sourceKey,entityId:original.entityId,record:original.record,collection:original.collection,detail,text}};});
